title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-wa51: SCHC WINDOW_SIZE=63 exceeds MAX_WINDOW_SIZE=62; TILE_SIZE=187 breaks real LoRa links
description:
## Summary

Two SCHC fragmentation constant changes are problematic:

### WINDOW_SIZE = 63 exceeds MAX_WINDOW_SIZE = 62

-  line 14: 
-  line 20:  (changed from previous value)
- WINDOW_SIZE=63 > MAX_WINDOW_SIZE=62 — direct contradiction within the same file
- Per SCHC RFC 8724, max window is 2^6-1 = 63 (6-bit field), but the local  says 62
- Either increase MAX_WINDOW_SIZE to 63 or reduce WINDOW_SIZE to ≤62

### TILE_SIZE = 187 incompatible with LoRa PHY

-  line 19:  (changed from 32)
- Each wire fragment = TILE_SIZE + 1 byte header = 188 bytes
- LoRa max payload per data rate:
  - SF7/125kHz: ≈222 bytes (barely fits)
  - SF9/125kHz: ≈115 bytes (rejected — packet > MTU)
  - SF12/125kHz: ≈51 bytes (rejected)
- This TILE_SIZE only works at SF7, breaks at all higher spreading factors
- For compatible LoRa SCHC profiles, TILE_SIZE should be ≤50 bytes to cover SF7-SF12

### Response buffer change

-  line 138: changed from  to 
- Need verification: with WINDOW_SIZE=63, the ACK response needs room for RuleID(1) + DTag(1) + W(6 bits) + bitmap(63 bits=8 bytes) + padding(1) + FCS(4) = ~15 bytes
- 16 bytes buffer is correct for WINDOW_SIZE=63, but the buffer was 10 before

### Notes

These changes cascade from the WINDOW_SIZE and TILE_SIZE adjustments. The spec (LICHEN-plan.md or draft) should define canonical SCHC tile/window sizes for LoRa profile.
